title: All design data is atomic JSON on the project filesystem, tracked by git
context: Alternative approaches: database backend; centralized server; nested file structures; binary formats.
decision: All Schematify design data is stored as atomic JSON files in a `.kaava/` directory on the project filesystem, tracked by git. One node per file. No graph index file exists. The atomic file structure enables concurrent agent branches.
consequences: Git tracks design history naturally; branches can diverge on design; merge conflicts are resolvable line-by-line; no centralized server needed for local work; loading must walk the directory and parse every file; no index to accelerate queries.
